description: This file defines a Python class 'CometAPIEmbeddingConfig' that provides configuration and transformation methods for integrating the CometAPI embedding service with an OpenAI-compatible API interface. It includes methods for URL construction, environment validation, parameter mapping, request transformation, response processing, and error handling, specifically tailored to CometAPI's specifications and response structure.

classes.name: CometAPIEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for CometAPI Embedding API, supporting URL construction, environment validation, parameter handling, request transformation, response parsing, and error handling in a manner compatible with OpenAI embedding interfaces.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete URL for the CometAPI embedding endpoint based on provided base URL and model.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and sets up the headers needed for authenticating with the CometAPI service, including retrieving the API key if not provided.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns the list of OpenAI-compatible embedding parameters supported by CometAPI.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI-style parameters to CometAPI-compatible parameters, updating the optional_params dictionary.

methods.name: dict transform_embedding_request( self, model: str, input: AllEmbeddingInputValues, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms input data into the format required by CometAPI for embedding requests.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse transform_embedding_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: EmbeddingResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str], request_data: dict, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Parses and converts the raw response from CometAPI into a standard EmbeddingResponse object.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns the appropriate exception class for errors encountered with CometAPI responses.
